units.text: We built REST API for partners with OAuth login and public changelog. Partner calls had 99.8% uptime in 6 months.
The team made nightly regression runs with Cypress. Release rollbacks went down from 9 to 3 per quarter.
I migrated 8 on-premise services to Azure with Terraform. Traffic I moved slowly with blue-green deployments. Whole move took 5 months and customers had no downtime.
